Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Serco purchased 1,234,083 Ordinary Shares between 02-Nov-2026 and 06-Nov-2026 under its buyback programme at average daily prices ranging 279.0013p–292.3343p (individual trade prices ranged 275.6p–294.0p), increasing treasury holdings to 46,107,850 shares and leaving 956,638,164 Ordinary Shares in issue (total voting rights 956,638,164); since the Programme opened on 11-Aug-2026 the Company has acquired 17,657,385 shares (approximately 1.85% of the issued share capital) which are held in treasury. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 06 November 2026 06 November 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (“ Ordinary Shares ”) through RBC Europe Limited. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
